# ANPR marocain v2 : E2.2 détecteur de caractères

Ce notebook entraîne un challenger léger `SSDLite320 MobileNetV3` sur des **crops de plaque uniquement**. Il détecte 40 classes fermées : chiffres `0–9`, les 15 séries arabes officielles et leurs 15 équivalents latins. La grammaire reconstruit ensuite la chaîne complète et s’abstient si la plaque, le marqueur `MA` ou la paire arabe/latin est incohérente.

#@title 2. Récupérer la branche scientifique exacte
REPOSITORY = 'https://github.com/getibplay-cmyk/pfe.git'
GIT_REF = 'science/moroccan-anpr-v2'
REPO_DIR = Path('/content/pfe')
if not REPO_DIR.exists():
    subprocess.run(['git', 'clone', '--filter=blob:none', '--branch', GIT_REF, '--single-branch', REPOSITORY, str(REPO_DIR)], check=True)
else:
    subprocess.run(['git', '-C', str(REPO_DIR), 'fetch', 'origin', GIT_REF], check=True)
    subprocess.run(['git', '-C', str(REPO_DIR), 'checkout', '--force', GIT_REF], check=True)
    subprocess.run(['git', '-C', str(REPO_DIR), 'reset', '--hard', f'origin/{GIT_REF}'], check=True)
GIT_SHA = subprocess.check_output(['git', '-C', str(REPO_DIR), 'rev-parse', 'HEAD'], text=True).strip()
required = [
    REPO_DIR / 'scripts/intelligence/vehicle_plate/character_detector.py',
    REPO_DIR / 'scripts/intelligence/vehicle_plate/generate_character_detection_dataset.py',
    REPO_DIR / 'scripts/intelligence/vehicle_plate/e2_character_detector.py',
    REPO_DIR / 'docs/intelligence/evidence/moroccan-anpr-public-source-registry-v1.json',
]
assert all(path.is_file() for path in required), required
print({'git_ref': GIT_REF, 'git_sha': GIT_SHA})

#@title 3. Vérifier l’environnement PyTorch/TorchVision permissif
subprocess.run([sys.executable, '-m', 'pip', 'install', '--disable-pip-version-check', 'Pillow==11.3.0'], check=True)
subprocess.run([sys.executable, '-m', 'pip', 'check'], check=True)
import PIL, torchvision
from torchvision.models import MobileNet_V3_Large_Weights
from torchvision.models.detection import ssdlite320_mobilenet_v3_large
probe = ssdlite320_mobilenet_v3_large(weights=None, weights_backbone=None, num_classes=41)
del probe
torch.cuda.empty_cache()
print({'python': sys.version.split()[0], 'torch': torch.__version__, 'torchvision': torchvision.__version__, 'pillow': PIL.__version__, 'cuda': torch.version.cuda, 'model': 'ssdlite320_mobilenet_v3_large', 'torchvision_license': 'BSD-3-Clause'})

#@title 4. Télécharger et vérifier les deux polices OFL gelées
ASSET_DIR = Path('/content/anpr_e22_assets')
ASSET_DIR.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
FONT_ARCHIVE = ASSET_DIR / 'NotoSansArabic-v2.013.zip'
FONT_ARCHIVE_URL = 'https://github.com/notofonts/arabic/releases/download/NotoSansArabic-v2.013/NotoSansArabic-v2.013.zip'
FONT_ARCHIVE_SHA256 = '1301aceaea84c501cf2e6dcfb3182e2328c8eae5725817fcb239672bda7154f1'
FONT_DIR = ASSET_DIR / 'noto-arabic-v2.013'
FONT_PATH = FONT_DIR / 'NotoSansArabic-SemiBold.ttf'
FONT_LICENSE = FONT_DIR / 'OFL.txt'
LATIN_FONT_PATH = ASSET_DIR / 'NotoSans-wdth-wght.ttf'
LATIN_FONT_URL = 'https://raw.githubusercontent.com/google/fonts/6a003b5eb672dc8bf5bff5937cf5863f8b175445/ofl/notosans/NotoSans%5Bwdth%2Cwght%5D.ttf'
LATIN_FONT_SHA256 = 'bfb7bb691513f12e734dc346c03a03f784912432d7e3fa8e56efcf906fe86b3d'
LATIN_FONT_LICENSE = ASSET_DIR / 'OFL-NotoSans.txt'
LATIN_FONT_LICENSE_URL = 'https://raw.githubusercontent.com/google/fonts/6a003b5eb672dc8bf5bff5937cf5863f8b175445/ofl/notosans/OFL.txt'
LATIN_FONT_LICENSE_SHA256 = 'cee9892f9f0cc8fe882c9e9537ee6a89621d86ee7ceaf70b02e2b2b1c25c061a'
def sha256(path):
    digest = hashlib.sha256()
    with Path(path).open('rb') as handle:
        for block in iter(lambda: handle.read(1024 * 1024), b''):
            digest.update(block)
    return digest.hexdigest()
if not FONT_ARCHIVE.is_file():
    urllib.request.urlretrieve(FONT_ARCHIVE_URL, FONT_ARCHIVE)
assert sha256(FONT_ARCHIVE) == FONT_ARCHIVE_SHA256
if not FONT_PATH.is_file() or not FONT_LICENSE.is_file():
    FONT_DIR.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    with zipfile.ZipFile(FONT_ARCHIVE) as archive:
        FONT_PATH.write_bytes(archive.read('NotoSansArabic/hinted/ttf/NotoSansArabic-SemiBold.ttf'))
        FONT_LICENSE.write_bytes(archive.read('OFL.txt'))
if not LATIN_FONT_PATH.is_file():
    urllib.request.urlretrieve(LATIN_FONT_URL, LATIN_FONT_PATH)
if not LATIN_FONT_LICENSE.is_file():
    urllib.request.urlretrieve(LATIN_FONT_LICENSE_URL, LATIN_FONT_LICENSE)
assert sha256(LATIN_FONT_PATH) == LATIN_FONT_SHA256
assert sha256(LATIN_FONT_LICENSE) == LATIN_FONT_LICENSE_SHA256
print({'arabic_archive_sha256': sha256(FONT_ARCHIVE), 'latin_font_sha256': sha256(LATIN_FONT_PATH), 'latin_license_sha256': sha256(LATIN_FONT_LICENSE)})

#@title 5. Générer le COCO synthétique de 40 classes sans split test
DATASET_DIR = Path('/content/anpr_e22_character_dataset')
assert not DATASET_DIR.exists(), f'Aucun écrasement autorisé: {DATASET_DIR}'
generate_command = [
    sys.executable, str(REPO_DIR / 'scripts/intelligence/vehicle_plate/generate_character_detection_dataset.py'),
    '--font', str(FONT_PATH), '--font-license', str(FONT_LICENSE),
    '--latin-font', str(LATIN_FONT_PATH), '--latin-font-license', str(LATIN_FONT_LICENSE),
    '--output-dir', str(DATASET_DIR), '--seed', str(SEED),
    '--train-groups', str(TRAIN_GROUPS), '--validation-groups', str(VALIDATION_GROUPS),
    '--calibration-groups', str(CALIBRATION_GROUPS), '--variants-per-group', str(VARIANTS_PER_GROUP),
    '--unified-fraction', str(UNIFIED_FRACTION),
]
subprocess.run(generate_command, cwd=REPO_DIR, check=True)
generation = json.loads((DATASET_DIR / 'generation_report.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
assert generation['qualification_claim'] is False and generation['final_test_opened'] is False
assert generation['contains_real_vehicle_data'] is False
assert len(generation['configuration']['alphabet']) == 40
assert set(generation['artifacts']['coco_annotations']) == {'train', 'validation', 'calibration'}
assert not (DATASET_DIR / 'annotations/instances_test.json').exists()
print({'groups': generation['artifacts']['groups'], 'images': generation['artifacts']['images'], 'characters': generation['artifacts']['characters'], 'classes': len(generation['configuration']['alphabet']), 'formats': generation['configuration']['format_group_counts'], 'test_rows': 0})

#@title 6. Entraîner SSDLite et sélectionner uniquement sur validation
LOCAL_OUTPUT = Path('/content/anpr_e22_character_run')
assert not LOCAL_OUTPUT.exists(), f'Aucun écrasement autorisé: {LOCAL_OUTPUT}'
train_command = [
    sys.executable, str(REPO_DIR / 'scripts/intelligence/vehicle_plate/e2_character_detector.py'),
    '--dataset-dir', str(DATASET_DIR), '--output-dir', str(LOCAL_OUTPUT),
    '--source-registry', str(REPO_DIR / 'docs/intelligence/evidence/moroccan-anpr-public-source-registry-v1.json'),
    '--repository-sha', GIT_SHA, '--epochs', str(EPOCHS), '--batch-size', str(BATCH_SIZE),
    '--score-threshold', str(SCORE_THRESHOLD), '--seed', str(SEED), '--num-workers', '2',
]
subprocess.run(train_command, cwd=REPO_DIR, check=True)
report = json.loads((LOCAL_OUTPUT / 'E2_CHARACTER_COMPLETE.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
assert report['status'] == 'synthetic_character_e2_complete_not_qualified'
assert report['synthetic_only'] is True and report['final_test_opened'] is False
assert report['qualification_claim'] is False and report['saas_integration_allowed'] is False
assert report['replacement_of_paddleocr_allowed'] is False
print(json.dumps({'status': report['status'], 'selection': report['selection'], 'final_test_opened': False, 'qualification_claim': False}, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2))

#@title 7. Vérifier puis sauvegarder le résultat dans votre Drive
def verify_sha256s(root):
    lines = (root / 'SHA256SUMS').read_text(encoding='utf-8').splitlines()
    assert lines
    for line in lines:
        expected, relative = line.split('  ', 1)
        assert sha256(root / relative) == expected, relative
    return len(lines)
verify_sha256s(LOCAL_OUTPUT)
freeze = subprocess.check_output([sys.executable, '-m', 'pip', 'freeze', '--all'], text=True)
(LOCAL_OUTPUT / 'runtime-pip-freeze.txt').write_text(freeze, encoding='utf-8')
files = sorted(path for path in LOCAL_OUTPUT.rglob('*') if path.is_file() and path.name != 'SHA256SUMS')
(LOCAL_OUTPUT / 'SHA256SUMS').write_text('\n'.join(f'{sha256(path)}  {path.relative_to(LOCAL_OUTPUT).as_posix()}' for path in files) + '\n', encoding='utf-8')
verified_files = verify_sha256s(LOCAL_OUTPUT)
SAVED_OUTPUT.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
shutil.copytree(LOCAL_OUTPUT, SAVED_OUTPUT)
assert verify_sha256s(SAVED_OUTPUT) == verified_files
sealed = json.loads((SAVED_OUTPUT / 'E2_CHARACTER_COMPLETE.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
print({'saved_to': str(SAVED_OUTPUT), 'files_verified': verified_files, 'validation_exact': sealed['selection']['validation']['full_plate_exact'], 'calibration_exact': sealed['selection']['calibration']['full_plate_exact'], 'status': sealed['status'], 'saas_integration_allowed': False})
